name: Dracula
description: Dracula Classic and its light counterpart Alucard, from the Dracula specification.

sources.author: Dracula Theme
files: https://draculatheme.com/spec (Dracula Classic and Alucard Classic palettes, UI colours, ANSI)
sources.note: The specification page was read on 2026-09-25; the VS Code repository supplies the licence and the UI mapping.

accent-hover.derived: accent with OKLab lightness moved 0.06 away from on-accent

accent-press.derived: accent with OKLab lightness moved 0.12 away from on-accent

scrim.derived: the darker of light.fg and dark.bg

success-text.derived: success (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

warning-text.derived: warning (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

danger-text.derived: danger (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

info-text.derived: info (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

fill.sage.bg.derived: desert sage lightness 0.758 and chroma 0.034 x 1.34 (the theme's green against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of green

fill.sage.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.sage.bg

fill.teal.bg.derived: desert teal lightness 0.853 and chroma 0.019 x 1.15 (the theme's cyan against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of cyan

fill.teal.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.teal.bg

fill.forest.bg.derived: desert forest lightness 0.229 and chroma 0.009 x 1.34 (the theme's green against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of green

fill.forest.ink.derived: light.bg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.forest.bg

fill.terracotta.bg.derived: desert terracotta lightness 0.662 and chroma 0.143 x 0.91 (the theme's orange against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of orange

fill.terracotta.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 6.1:1 on fill.terracotta.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 5.11:1)

fill.sand.bg.derived: desert sand lightness 0.859 and chroma 0.019 x 0.74 (the theme's yellow against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of yellow

fill.sand.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.sand.bg

fill.warm-grey.bg.derived: desert warm-grey lightness 0.776; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)

fill.warm-grey.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.warm-grey.bg

fill.clay-red.bg.derived: desert clay-red lightness 0.576 and chroma 0.200 x 1.08 (the theme's red against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of red

fill.clay-red.ink.derived: light.bg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.clay-red.bg

fill.dark-teal.bg.derived: desert dark-teal lightness 0.408 and chroma 0.058 x 2.50 (the theme's blue against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of blue

fill.dark-teal.ink.derived: light.bg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.dark-teal.bg

fill.dusty-pink.bg.derived: desert dusty-pink lightness 0.704 and chroma 0.039 x 2.50 (the theme's magenta against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of magenta

fill.dusty-pink.ink.derived: light.fg moved in OKLab lightness to 7.0:1 on fill.dusty-pink.bg (light.fg and light.bg reach 5.97:1)

fill.light-peach.bg.derived: desert light-peach lightness 0.911 and chroma 0.040 x 0.91 (the theme's orange against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of orange

fill.light-peach.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.light-peach.bg

fill.faun.bg.derived: desert faun lightness 0.826 and chroma 0.017 x 0.74 (the theme's yellow against desert's, at most the theme's own), the hue of yellow

fill.faun.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.faun.bg

fill.cool-grey.bg.derived: desert cool-grey lightness 0.899; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)

fill.cool-grey.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.cool-grey.bg

fill.stone.bg.derived: desert stone lightness 0.753; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)

fill.stone.ink.derived: light.fg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.stone.bg

fill.dark-grey.bg.derived: desert dark-grey lightness 0.518; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)

fill.dark-grey.ink.derived: light.bg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.dark-grey.bg

fill.ink.bg.derived: desert ink lightness 0.175; the theme's neutral hue and chroma (at most 0.03)

fill.ink.ink.derived: light.bg, the better of light.fg and light.bg on fill.ink.bg
